task: Audit the wire-format description for behavioral sufficiency. Determine whether format.md fully determines the output of the encoder on every probe in probes.json — that is, whether format.md is a sufficient behavioral specification of reference.py over these probes — and report every behavior the probes exercise that the description does not determine.

shape.findings: on UNDERDETERMINED: {underdetermined_behaviors: [description], divergent_probe_indices: sorted list, per_probe: [{probe_index, reference_output, independent_output}]}; on SUFFICIENT: {agreement: 'all probes'}

evidence_requirements: E-A: identification of each behavior exercised by the probes that format.md does not determine, or an explicit argument that none exists

E-B: an empirical item-level comparison over probes.json between reference.py and an implementation of format.md authored strictly from format.md, by an implementer with no access to reference.py and no access to any analysis derived from reference.py; the implementation must be a python file exposing encode(d: dict) -> str so the comparison is mechanically reproducible
E-C: the verdict follows from E-A and E-B together: UNDERDETERMINED iff some probe admits more than one format-conforming output or the clean implementation diverges from reference.py on some probe
verification_method: deterministic root verification per the preregistered method for this trial
